title: A native chat, rebuilt · 0.4.2
description: Chat works like the AI apps you know: your question moves to the top, replies are formatted, one Liquid Glass chat bar, a sidebar that follows your finger, and comfortable at every text size.
notes: Sending puts your question at the top of the screen and the reply writes below it; a Latest button appears when the end is out of view.
Replies show headings, lists, quotes, tables and code blocks with Copy, all selectable.
One Liquid Glass chat bar with +, your message and Send or Stop; tap or drag the conversation to put the keyboard away.
The model is the chat's title; tap it to switch.
Swipe right anywhere and the chat slides aside to reveal the sidebar, following your finger; swipe left or tap the chat to close.
Buttons and icons grow with your text size up to the largest accessibility sizes; VoiceOver names every control.
Plain error messages, light haptics, and no placeholder screens in the sidebar.
